text:
zoe: Ran the csharp onboarding sample on Windows with parallel pagination and hit quota stomps during dev load. Symptoms: lots of 401->refresh->retries and then 429 bursts.
patrick: Which SDK version and sample settings?
zoe: csharp-sdk 0.6.1, sample: `parallelPages=16`, `workerPool=12`.
mike: That creates many inflight requests when each page prefetches next N links. Any retry config?
zoe: Default retry (3 fixed retries, 200ms). No jitter.
patrick: Two things: add a refresh lock so only one thread refreshes tokens per client, and switch to decorrelated jitter for retries. Also add a small semaphore around prefetch so effective concurrency = min(workerPool, parallelPages).
mike: Agreed. Suggest adding an adaptive token-bucket limiter that seeds from an initial probe to /v1/limits which returns `x-rate-limit-limit`. If header missing, fall back to conservative 10 rps. Also expose an env `ONBOARD_RAMP_MS` to stagger workers at startup.
zoe: I'll patch sampleapp defaults: `parallelPages=4`, `workerPool=6`, `retryPolicy=exponential+jitter`, `refreshLock=true`. Add a test harness that mocks auth endpoint to assert only one refresh occurs.
patrick: Nice. Also emit telemetry events `sdk.rate_limit.headers` and `sdk.onboard.ramp` so we can tune defaults.
auth-bot: Alert: onboarding-csharp-prod tripped per-tenant cap at 2026-03-22T11:10:02Z; auto-throttle applied.
zoe: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/csharp-onboard-samples/pull/21 — includes limiter + refresh-lock + docs about "ramp not blast". PTAL @patrick @mike
mike: LGTM, will add semaphore helper to SDK core and a one-line note in quickstart about prefetch tradeoffs.
patrick: Thanks — small changes but should prevent auth stampedes and quota surges.
